newsitem.title: UK: UK stocks drop as rate fears shake Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: UK stocks drop as rate fears shake Wall Street.

text.p: UK shares fell on Friday as stronger-than-expected U.S. jobs data sent U.S. stocks and bonds sharply lower amid fresh fears of a rise in U.S. interest rates.
The FTSE 100 ended 30.4 points lower at 4,056.6, its lowest close for three weeks, led by retailers as a profit warning by Argos added to sector woes. Decliners led gainers three-to-one.

Stocks ended off the day's lows as the Dow rallied from an initial tumble of more than 50 points, to be down just 28 points as London closed. Yet with the benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury bond down well over a full point, traders and strategists said the near-term UK outlook was mixed at best.
